**What happened**
What you did, what you expected, and what Gamp did instead.

**Gamp said**
The message in the display (CAN'T PLAY: …), if there was one.

**Where**
Gamp version (right-click › About Gamp…), macOS / Windows / Linux, and what you were playing (a file, SoundCloud, Spotify, Plex…).
